recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Leaving California for Idaho", "body": "Buffalo and Leggs described leaving Orange County and corporate jobs for a quiet Idaho town, where they said patience and a slower pace were the main lessons. They told Chance they had accepted an offer on their first home after holding a thank you ceremony in it, and shared small synchronicities, from a U-Haul driver's business tips to neighbors who already knew their parents. They also admitted the temporary housing was cramped. Chance linked the slowing down to Aries habits of rushing ahead, and the group traded stories about deer, raptors, and local raw milk."}, {"title": "Awaken Slaves and self reliance", "body": "Chance argued that the culture pushed everyone into taking turns as master and slave, with a currency he called debt rather than money. He claimed that if people looked after themselves first, nobody would need slaves, and that reliance on someone self reliant was healthier. One of the couple said depending on neighbors beat waiting on government help. Later Buffalo said his show Awaken Slaves would stream on Rokfin and focus on the divine masculine, while Leggs would host Vacation Forever about wildlife, and a host added that protecting did not have to mean controlling."}, {"title": "Temperance, the one mind, and prayer", "body": "Chance noted that episode fourteen matched the Temperance card, ruled by Sagittarius, and described people as small receivers of one shared mind. A guest argued that duality was something others created, since nature showed a combination of impermanence and permanence. Chance proposed praying as thanks and affirmation instead of requests, and a guest recalled a George Carlin routine about prayer. Chance said free will meant flowing with the plan, with Temperance as the balance of elements."}, {"title": "Tarot, wordplay, and targeting the seer", "body": "After Gabe joined, Chance said he had an intuitive sense that Sagittarius, the seer and archer, had been targeted on the archetypal plane. Gabe then offered an anagram, saying the letters of the great reset could spell target the seer, and Buffalo wondered whether that was a message to decode. Chance described Gabe's idea of laying tarot cards over a Mercator world map as synchromysticism, a way to find meaning rather than proof. One host tied the number fourteen to the hands and to the word no."}, {"title": "Readings, decks, and the left brain", "body": "Chance pulled an I Ching Wanderer and Revolution reading for the pair, then drew the Ten of Cups and Two of Cups, calling the second a Temperance image of two people keeping their own cups full. Buffalo was still holding an unshuffled Heindl deck, and Chance suggested honoring a new deck by naming the question and birth date aloud. One host argued shuffling moved cards from left brain order into right brain mystery, and Gabe said everyone could benefit from a relationship with the cards."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Leggs and Buffalo Rambler are hosts of False Reality Check Podcast. Tonight we'll hang out with this fiery duo and find out what it means to awaken the slaves and vacation forever.
